articles.title: 'Devoted' father and grandfather-to-be swimming at popular beach killed in suspected fatal shark attack - foxnews.com
articles.description: Greg O'Neill, 63, was attacked by a great white shark at Sorrento Beach in Perth, Western Australia, prompting a rare catch-and-kill order.
articles.content:
